entities.name: Hü King Eng
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hü King Eng was a physician, and the second ethnic Chinese woman to attend university in the United States, after King You Mé. Her medical career is well-documented, as she was treated as a celebrity by American media, due to the lack of even American women studying medicine at the time.

entities.name: Hü King Eng
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hü King Eng was a physician, and the second ethnic Chinese woman to attend university in the United States, after King You Mé. Her medical career is well-documented, as she was treated as a celebrity by American media, due to the lack of even American women studying medicine at the time.
